name: Sayonara, Utsutsu.
source:
"You have to save this world. That's not my whim, the world itself desires it."
The transfer student by the name Mimiyo said that and gave Kazuki a syringe. By using it he traveled to a different world "Mundos" that, in some ways, resembles reality. There he fought, as a savior, against monsters called "Mortalis" that destroy the very fabric of the reality he knows. That brought an end to his "role" and "everyday life" he was so fed up with. Like mad he spent his time as a hero fighting for the world's salvation. A true story that from a first glance resembles drug-induced hallucinations.
translation:
“你必须拯救这个世界。这不是我的心血来潮，世界本身就渴望这样。”
名叫美美代的转校生这么说着，递给一树注射器。通过使用它，他旅行到了一个在某些方面类似于现实的异世界“Mundos”。在那里，他作为救世主与被称为“Mortalis”的怪物战斗，这些怪物摧毁了他所知道的现实的结构。这结束了他厌倦的“角色”和“日常生活”。他疯狂地把自己的时间花在了为拯救世界而奋斗的英雄身上。这是一个乍一看类似于药物引起的幻觉的真实故事。
